payment_terms.quote: Charterer shall satisfy all ocean freight invoices under payment terms of Net 30 days from presentation of bill of lading.

price_adjustment.quote: Base freight rates are linked to the Platts Marine Bunker Fuel Index and subject to index-linked quarterly adjustments.

contract_term.quote: The vessel charter duration shall be 24 months commencing May 1, 2024.

auto_renewal.quote: This charter shall automatically renew for successive 12-month periods unless notice of redelivery is provided.

termination_notice.quote: Either party may terminate this vessel charter upon giving written notice of at least 90 days.

liability_cap.quote: The aggregate liability of Owner for cargo loss or vessel delay shall not exceed 1,500,000 EUR.

governing_law.quote: It is expressly agreed that the governing law shall be the laws of Germany.
